text:
tia: trying to cut the sampleapp SDK release but CI blocked on a semver + regen mismatch. weird interaction with auth/retry test failures. anyone?
mike: saw the job. publish job aborted because package.json version didn't match the git tag churn from the release script. the typegen check ran after the version bump and failed.
dev-tools: CI snippet:
```
ci-bot: job 10521 - prepublish-checks failed
Error: version mismatch: package.json v1.5.2 != tag v1.5.3
Also: regen diff in src/gen/types.ts (type hash mismatch)
```
tia: hmm, our release script runs automated changelog bump + semver then triggers typegen in a separate step. if someone manually pushed a hotfix commit that bumped package.json on the release branch, the tag can be out-of-sync.
sam: also saw transient auth/retry unit tests failing on the sampleapp integration suite which caused a rerun that rehydrated caches differently. that might have changed the generated output order in a previous run.
qa: sequence I saw: 1) release script bumps to x.y.z+1 and pushes commit, 2) parallel PR merged that altered CHANGELOG formatting, 3) CI runs regen and sees diffs.
mike: short-term unblock: pick a canonical commit (the one with correct package.json), run `yarn typegen --regen` locally from that commit, commit generated files, and re-run pipeline. bump patch semver if needed.
dev-tools: long-term fixes: 1) make release script do an atomic commit/tag (single transactional push) so semver and generated files are always consistent, 2) enforce a pre-push hook in release pipeline that runs `typegen --check`, 3) stabilize generator output (sort keys/enums).
tia: I can repro locally and will push a regen+patch bump from the release branch. I'll include the exact release script SHA and CI job links in the commit message.
ci-bot: rerun job 10521 -> typegen-check passed
ci-bot: publish job started for sampleapp-sdk v1.5.3
sam: assigning DEVEX-931 to tracking deterministic gen + release script atomicity. tagging eng-tooling.
tia: thanks all, will follow up with a short doc in the release playbook to avoid manual bumps in parallel to the automated script. :thumbsup:
